title: Adapter
prompt: You must call a vendor SDK with a weird API; your domain already depends on a MetricsPort interface you own. Move?

choices.label: Write an Adapter implementing MetricsPort around the SDK
choices.consequence: Keep your interface; wrap what you do not own.

choices.label: Change all callers to vendor types
Fork and rewrite the vendor SDK tonight
Put the SDK in a global static and hope
